subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Diego Rivera (1886-1957) was a Mexican muralist and painter.
• During his career, he created many influential public artworks.
• His mural Detroit Industry was completed in 1933 at the Detroit Institute of Arts.
• It is considered one of the finest examples of Mexican muralism in the United States.
prompt: The student wants to introduce Diego Rivera to an audience unfamiliar with his career. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Diego Rivera is the artist behind Detroit Industry, a mural completed in 1933 at the Detroit Institute of Arts.
choices.B: Completed in 1933 at the Detroit Institute of Arts, Detroit Industry is a mural by Diego Rivera.
choices.C: Detroit Industry by Diego Rivera is considered one of the finest examples of Mexican muralism in the United States.
choices.D: Mexican muralist and painter Diego Rivera created many influential public artworks during his career, including Detroit Industry, one of the finest examples of Mexican muralism in the United States.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence introduces Diego Rivera to an audience unfamiliar with his career, identifying him as an influential Mexican muralist and painter and noting a career accomplishment.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence explains that a mural created by Rivera is considered one of the finest examples of Mexican muralism; it doesn't introduce Rivera to an audience unfamiliar with his career.
